newsitem.title: USA: Kodak to form alliance with printing co - WSJ.
newsitem.headline: Kodak to form alliance with printing co - WSJ.

text.p: Eastman Kodak Co's professional imaging unit is expected to form an alliance with Heidelberger Druckmaschinen AG that would include joint development of new printing products, the Wall Street Journal said.

In Tuesday's electronic edition, the Journal said the deal was likely to also include combined marketing and sales efforts between Kodak's second-largest division and the world's largest maker of printing presses.

Michael Simmonds, Kodak's vice president and general manager of graphics systems markets, said the companies see opportunity for printing growth in developing markets such as China, as well as in existing markets such as Japan and Western Europe.
The alliance is expected to be announced later on Tuesday at a trade show in Dusseldorf, Germany. Financial terms are not expected to be disclosed, the Journal said.
